about_the_game:
With this DLC, you can enjoy a special snow-themed version of the popular virtual singer "Hatsune Miku" called "SNOW MIKU 2025 Ver." All new motions that are different from those of the regular Hatsune Miku are included, and all gestures and movements that can be seen on Desktop Mate are also exclusive to this version. She can move around freely on the desktop, sit on the window, play with the mouse, and more, delivering a fascinating experience that only Desktop Mate can offer.

  • Stunning graphics and lifelike movements powered by cutting-edge 3D technology.

  • Meticulously new crafted 3D models.

  • 29 unique and original animations.

* Please note that this DLC will be available until January 31, 2026. The period may be extended or resold as the case may be.

* Desktop Mate is required to use this content. Please update to the latest version before use.

* This content must be used in accordance with the “PIAPRO CHARACTER LICENSE”.

* According to this license, this content may be used for video distribution on platforms such as YouTube, NicoNico Douga, and Twitch.

* This content does not include voices.

Contents included in this product

SNOW MIKU 2025 Ver.
